scientific_integrity: The accompanying proof establishes all-length claims; the independent finite enumerator provides cross-checks, not an independent audit. No assertion of publication priority or general algorithmic novelty is made.
scientific_limitations: The classification and length generating functions concern binary privileged words with exactly three ones. They do not determine unrestricted privilege counts or fixed weights at least four. Equivalent enumerations in unindexed literature remain possible. The all-length proof is deductive; finite checks are corroborative only.
title: Exact Hamming-weight-three classification of privileged binary words
